title: Poisson-Dirichlet factorization of prime predecessors
exact_target: For each prime $p>=3$ list the prime factors of p-1, counting multiplicity, in descending order and divide their logarithms by log(p-1), padding with zeros. Do the first k coordinates, for every fixed k, converge in distribution under ordinary uniform prime counting $p<=X$ to the decreasing rearrangement of the stick-breaking sequence U1,(1-U1)U2,(1-U1)(1-U2)U3,... for independent uniform Uj on (0,1)?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: The Poisson–Dirichlet law for prime predecessors
